title: 第六章 懵逼的二叔
content_zh:
“喂！”名叫采薇的黄裙少女，扑闪着美眸，“为什么盐能变成银子？”
她说完，犹豫一下，抽出一根甘蔗递给许七安：“喏，这个给你吃。”
这是在收买我吗....
两位大人已经没了踪影，许七安收回目光，想了想，回答道：“草民曾在古籍中见过将盐变成银子的炼金秘籍。”
黄裙少女瞪大眼睛：“哪本古籍在哪里？著作者是谁？”
它的名字叫《高中化学》，至于著作者....嗯，人民教育出版社？许七安道：“古籍早已毁掉，不过，在下还记得其中内容。”
黄裙少女呼吸一下急促：“快，快告诉我。”
许七安叹口气：“草民危在旦夕，实在没有心情为人师。”
黄裙少女给了他一个白眼，没好气道：
“你这人倒是滑头。我们司天监不干涉朝政，怎么处置你，还得陛下说了算，与我待价而沽，毫无意义。”
“你们把我收了不就行了，以监正大人在朝中的地位，要一个连坐人犯想来是没问题的。”许七安说。
他得为自己加一个保险，万一找不回税银呢。
黄裙少女明眸流转，上下审视：“你明明是个武夫，为何要当术士。”
修行要趁早，大部分修行者都是自幼打下的基础。现在武夫转术士，为时晚矣。
“抱不抱大腿的无所谓，主要是仰慕监正大人的风采。”许七安语气虔诚，表情认真。
“那你先把炼金古籍内容告诉我。”她斟酌道，少女的眼睛是澄澈明亮的，大大的杏眼，乌黑的瞳仁，黑白分明。
许七安前世只在孩子身上见过这种干净漂亮的眸子。
“内容有些艰涩深奥，只是口述，恐怕你无法理解。需得深入浅出的授业，方能根深蒂固。”许七安钓鱼。
褚采薇翻了个白眼，不服气：“放眼九州天下，论炼金术，我司天监术士当为魁首。”
“氢氦锂铍硼碳氮氧氟氖钠镁铝硅磷.....”许七安倒背如流。

“？？？”
他在说什么东西？少女懵了半天，柳眉倒竖：“你耍我。我们司天监收弟子，只收童子。”
她把许七安手里的甘蔗抢了回来。
脚步轻盈的走了，裙裾飞扬。
我也是童子啊....许七安张了张嘴，随后明白过来，司天监收弟子，是从娃娃抓起。
得，这条路没得走。
......
一晃两天过去，许七安在牢房里担惊受怕的度过了两天。
他害怕税银没能及时追回来，如果是在他流放之后，便是追回来也改变不了结局。
然后，万一陈府尹是个黑了心的蛆，独吞功劳，依旧是死局。
可是没办法啊，他只能做到这一步了，一个阶下囚，又能如何？
许七安又一次感受到了封建社会的可怕。
“听天由命吧....”许七安哀叹一声。
‘哐！’
走廊尽头的铁门”
许七安狂喜，用力握紧拳头：“税银找回来了？”
“随我去签字画押，你就可以离开了。”狱卒审视着他：“你小子命真大。”
“那我二叔呢？”许七安急切追问。
“别废话，跟来就是。”狱卒脾气很暴躁，火棍一敲许七安翘臀，赶着他离开牢房。
在衙门一位吏员安排下，他签字画押，随后从狱卒那里得到了自己被打入大牢时拔掉的衣服。

一位衙役领着他离开京兆府衙门，从后门出去。
这时候，东边微熹，街道清冷。
......
徐志平被铁门
蓬头垢面的许平志，面容与许七安有些相似，反倒是亲生儿子的许新年，五官过于俊俏，与他俩迥异。
隔着一条走廊的对面牢房内，昏睡中的李茹浑身一震，随之惊醒，她面容憔悴，脸上露出极度惊恐的表情。
夫妻俩隔着一道走廊相望，李茹凄然道：“老爷，我便是死，也不会进教坊司。”
她今年三十五岁，保养得当，是风韵极佳的美妇，即使在牢里担惊受怕了五天，形容憔悴，依旧难掩那眉眼间的风情。
教坊司是什么地方？
是女人的炼狱。
伤痕累累的许平志张了张嘴，说不出话来，忽地热泪纵横：“夫人，是我对不住你。我们夫妻俩共赴黄泉，下辈子我给你做牛做马补偿你。只是可怜了孩子，还有我那侄儿。”
五天已过，迎接他的是开刀问斩，迎接加重女眷的是教坊司。除了李茹外，许家还有两个闺女，一个年芳二八的长女，一个五岁的幼女。
她们蜷缩在牢房角落里，此时也被惊醒了。
五岁的幼女揉着眼睛，呢喃着“娘亲”，她对自己的命令一无所知。
十六岁的少女坐起身，散乱的秀发衬着一张白皙的瓜子脸，小嘴薄而红润，眼睛大而有神，她的鼻子不像一般的女人那样小巧，而是挺拔。于是就显得五官特别有立体感，特别精致漂亮。
有种静雕般的美感。
她下意识的往母亲身边靠，浓密的睫毛因为害怕轻轻颤抖。
几名狱卒腰胯朴刀，大步昂扬的进来。
李茹眼里闪绝望和决然。
许平志双手握紧栅栏，骨节苍白，钢牙紧咬，丢失税银，渎职，他自认该死，但连累家中妻女，死不瞑目。

尤其幼女，年仅五岁，便要送去教坊司养着，人生一片黑暗。
为人父母，如何能甘心。
“许平志，随我等出来，签字画押后就可以离开了。”狱卒己出来。
“许平志一生爱国忠君，满门忠烈.....诶，你说什么？”许二叔怀疑自己听错了。
几个意思啊？
“可以离开？你刚才说可以离开。”许平志一时间难以置信：“怎么回事，你们不是带我出去斩首吗。”
“不知道。”狱卒没好气道：“这是上头的命令，想知道自己出去问。”
李茹茫然忐忑，牵着两个女儿，一家人沉默的跟在狱卒身后，朝廊道尽头走去。
“老，老爷....不会是骗我们的吧？”
“岂会如此儿戏。”许平志身上带伤，走路一撅一拐，他也一头雾水，有大难不死的喜悦，也有搞不清楚状况的茫然。
李茹心里一动：“是新年，定是新年这几日在外奔走，帮我们打点关系，才让朝廷网开一面。”
她越想越觉得有可能，激动道：“老爷莫要忘了，新年的老师，是元景18年的刑部侍郎。”
元景18年....都二十多年前了....许平志觉得不对，又想不出除此外，官场没大靠山的自己还能指望谁。
“或许吧。”
“我就说咱们家新年是人中之龙，当年我让他习武，你不答应，非要让许七安那小兔崽子练武。”
“娘，兔兔好可爱，我想吃兔兔。”幼女仰起小脸蛋，啃着自己的小指头，眼里写着“馋”字。
“成天就知道吃....”脾气躁的李茹下意识骂了一句，看着小脸脏兮兮的幼女，脸色随即柔和，“乖，马上就有兔兔吃了。”
许平志懒得跟她解释‘你儿子没有习武天赋’这件事。反正不管说多少遍，结发妻子都会自动忽略。
当妈的眼里，儿子永远是最优秀的。
到了签字画押之处，许平志从府衙吏员手中接过笔，手指微微颤抖，签完名字，按了手印，许平志感觉自己得到了某种升华。

就像深埋地底的种子钻出幼苗，见到了阳光。
世界忽然变的如此美好，明明一个铜板都没有多出来。
妻女则不需要署名，仅是按了手印。
许平志按捺不住内心的好奇，拱手道：“这位大人，不知，不知为何免了我等罪过。”
李茹立刻看向吏员。
“案子破了，税银已经追回。”吏员回答。
“税银追回了？哈哈，好，好！该死的妖孽，竟敢劫我大奉税银。”
许二叔颇为振奋，笑完又觉得，依照大奉律法，税银固然追回，可他渎职也是真的。
追回税银又不是他的功劳，朝廷怎么会免他死罪？
即使从宽发落，也是流放边陲。
“许大人，这是你的官袍，收好了。”吏员将之前拔下来的八品武官绿袍奉上。
竟然还官复原职....许平志意识到不对劲了，边接过官袍，边沉声道：“这位大人，可否为本官解惑？”
官袍在手，这声本官说出口都有了几分底气。
按道理，就算免了死罪，也不该是官复原职。
“大奉律法规定，家中长辈有触发律法者，子嗣可为父戴罪立功。”吏员说道。
“真的是年儿，老爷，年儿助朝廷追回了税银。”李茹喜极而泣。
“年儿....”许平志眼眶湿润：“我的好儿子啊。”
吏员看了激动的夫妻俩一眼，“是你侄儿许七安，他助府尹大人破了税银案，人刚走。”
content_en:
"Hey!" A girl in a yellow dress named Caiwei flashed her beautiful eyes, "Why can salt turn into silver?"
After she finished speaking, she hesitated, took out a sugar cane and handed it to Xu Qian: "Here, this is for you to eat."
Are you trying to bribe me?
The two adults had disappeared. Xu Qi'an looked away, thought for a while, and replied: "Caomin has seen the alchemy secret book that turns salt into silver in ancient books."
The girl in the yellow dress widened her eyes: "Which ancient book is where? Who is the author?"
Its name is "High School Chemistry", and as for the author...well, People's Education Press? Xu Qian said: "The ancient book has been destroyed long ago, but I still remember its contents."
The girl in the yellow skirt breathed quickly: "Quickly, tell me quickly."
Xu Qian sighed: "The common people are in danger, and I really am not in the mood to be a teacher."
The girl in the yellow dress gave him a roll of her eyes and said angrily:
"You are a slippery person. We, Si Tianjian, do not interfere in government affairs. It is up to His Majesty to decide how to deal with you. It is meaningless to wait for a price with me."
"Why don't you just take me in? Given Master Jianzheng's position in the court, it's no problem to have a serial prisoner here." Xu Qian said.
He had to add insurance for himself in case he couldn't get his tax money back.
The bright eyes of the girl in the yellow dress moved, looking up and down: "You are obviously a martial artist, why do you want to be a warlock."
You should start practicing as early as possible. Most practitioners have laid the foundation since childhood. It's too late for a warrior to become a sorcerer now.
"It doesn't matter whether I hug you or not. The main thing is that I admire Lord Jianzheng's demeanor." Xu Qian's tone was pious and his expression was serious.
"Then tell me the content of the ancient alchemy book first." She considered it. The girl's eyes were clear and bright, with big almond eyes, black pupils, and clear black and white.
Xu Qi'an had only seen such clean and beautiful eyes on children in her previous life.
"The content is a bit difficult and profound. It's just spoken, so I'm afraid you won't be able to understand it. Only by teaching in a simple and profound way can it be deeply ingrained." Xu Qian fished.
Chu Caiwei rolled her eyes and was unconvinced: "Looking at the world of Jiuzhou, when it comes to alchemy, our Heavenly Supervisor Warlock should be the leader."
"Hydrogen, helium, lithium, beryllium, boron, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, fluorine, neon, sodium, magnesium, aluminum, silicon, phosphorus..." Xu Qian recited it fluently.
"???"
What is he talking about? The girl was stunned for a long time, and her eyebrows stood up: "You are kidding me. Our Si Tianjian accepts disciples, only boys."
She snatched the sugar cane back from Xu Qian's hand.
She walked away with light steps, her skirt flying.
I am also a boy...Xu Qi'an opened his mouth, and then realized that Si Tianjian recruited his disciples from babies.
Yes, there is no way to go this way.
...
Two days passed in a flash, and Xu Qian spent two days in fear in the cell.
He was afraid that the tax money would not be recovered in time. If it was after he was exiled, even if he recovered it, it would not change the outcome.
Then, if Chen Fuyin is a malicious maggot and takes all the credit, it will still be a dead end.
But there is no other way. He can only do this one step. What can he do if he is a prisoner?
Xu Qian once again felt the horror of feudal society.
"Leave it to fate..." Xu Qian lamented.
‘Bang! ’
The iron door at the end of the corridor”
Xu Qian was ecstatic and clenched his fists hard: "Did you get your tax money back? "
"Follow me to sign and seal it, and you can leave. The jailer looked at him: "You are so lucky." "
"What about my second uncle? "Xu Qian asked eagerly.
"Stop talking nonsense, just follow me. "The jailer was very grumpy. He hit Xu Qian's buttocks with a fire stick and drove him out of the cell.
Under the arrangement of an official in the yamen, he signed and stamped his name, and then obtained from the jailer the clothes he had removed when he was imprisoned.
A yamen servant led him out of the Jingzhao Mansion Yamen and out the back door.
At this time, it was slightly dark in the east and the streets were cold.
...Xu Zhiping was imprisoned
The disheveled Xu Pingzhi's face is somewhat similar to Xu Qian's, but Xu Xinnian, his biological son, has very handsome features and is completely different from them.
In the opposite cell across the corridor, Li Ru, who was sleeping, was shaken all over and then woke up. She looked haggard and had an expression of extreme fear on her face.
The couple looked at each other across the corridor, and Li Ru said sadly: "Master, even if I die, I will not enter the Jiaofang Division."
She is thirty-five years old, well-maintained, and a beautiful woman with great charm. Even though she was frightened in jail for five days and looked haggard, she still couldn't hide the charm in her eyebrows.
Where is Jiaofangsi?
It is a purgatory for women.
The scarred Xu Pingzhi opened his mouth, unable to speak, and suddenly burst into tears: "Madam, I can't help you. We both went to hell together, and I will work hard to make up for you in the next life. I just pitied the child and my nephew."
Five days had passed, and he was greeted by the knife and beheading, and the Jiaofangsi was greeted by the aggravated female family members. In addition to Li Ru, the Xu family also has two daughters, an eldest daughter who is twenty-eight years old, and a five-year-old daughter.
They were huddled in the corner of the cell and were also awakened at this time.
The five-year-old girl rubbed her eyes and murmured "Mother". She knew nothing about her order.
The sixteen-year-old girl sat up. Her messy hair framed a fair face with oval seeds. Her mouth was thin and red, and her eyes were big and bright. Her nose was not as small as that of ordinary women, but straight and straight. As a result, the facial features appear particularly three-dimensional, exquisite and beautiful.
There is a kind of beauty like a static sculpture.
She subconsciously leaned toward her mother, her thick eyelashes trembling slightly because of fear.
Several jailers strode in with simple swords on their waists and hips.
Li Ru's eyes flashed with despair and determination.
Xu Pingzhi clenched the fence with both hands, his joints were pale, and his steel teeth were clenched. He had lost his tax money and was derelict in his duties. He thought he deserved to die, but he had harmed his wife and daughter at home, and he would not die in peace.
Especially the little girl, who is only five years old, has to be sent to the priest to be raised, and her life is dark.
How can one be willing to be a parent?
"Xu Pingzhi, come out with me, and you can leave after signing and signing." The jailer had come out.
"Xu Pingzhi was patriotic and loyal throughout his life, and his whole family was loyal... Hey, what did you say?" Second Uncle Xu suspected that he heard wrongly.
What do you mean?
"Can you leave? You just said you can leave." Xu Pingzhi couldn't believe it for a moment: "What's going on? Didn't you take me out to behead me?"
"I don't know." The jailer said angrily, "This is an order from above. If you want to know, go out and ask."
Li Ru was confused and worried, holding her two daughters, and the whole family followed the jailer in silence towards the end of the corridor.
"Old, Master... He's not lying to us, is he?"
"How can it be such a child's play?" Xu Pingzhi was injured and walked with a stagger. He was also confused. He felt happy about surviving a disaster, but also confused about not understanding the situation.
Li Ru's heart moved: "It's the New Year, so I must be running around during the New Year to help us deal with the relationship, so that the imperial court can be lenient."
The more she thought about it, the more likely it was that she thought it was possible, and said excitedly: "Master, please don't forget that the teacher for the New Year is the minister of punishment in the 18th year of Yuanjing."
Yuan Jing was 18 years old...it was more than 20 years ago...Xu Pingzhi felt something was wrong, but he couldn't think of anyone else he could count on since he had no big backer in the officialdom.
"Maybe."
"I just said that our family is a dragon among people in the New Year. I asked him to practice martial arts back then, but you didn't agree and insisted on letting that little brat Xu Qian practice martial arts."
"Mom, the rabbit is so cute. I want to eat the rabbit." The little girl raised her little face and bit her little finger, with the word "greedy" written in her eyes.
"I know how to eat all day long..." The grumpy Li Ru cursed subconsciously. Looking at the dirty-faced young girl, her expression softened and said, "Be good, there will be rabbits to eat soon."
Xu Pingzhi was too lazy to follow herExplain the matter of 'your son has no talent for martial arts'. Anyway, no matter how many times I say it, my married wife will automatically ignore it.
In the eyes of a mother, her son is always the best.
When he arrived at the place where the signature was signed, Xu Pingzhi took the pen from the government official's hand. His fingers trembled slightly. After signing his name and pressing his fingerprint, Xu Pingzhi felt that he had gained some kind of sublimation.
Just like a seed buried deep in the ground, it emerges as a seedling and sees the sun.
The world suddenly became so beautiful, even though there was not even a single extra copper penny left.
The wife and daughter do not need to sign, they just need to take their fingerprints.
Xu Pingzhi couldn't suppress his inner curiosity and said, "My lord, I don't know why, but I don't know why you have exempted us from our sins."
Li Ru immediately looked at the official.
"The case has been solved and the tax money has been recovered." the official replied.
"The tax money has been recovered? Haha, okay, okay! Damn monster, how dare you rob me of my big tax money."
Uncle Xu was quite excited. After laughing, he felt that although the tax money would be recovered according to Dafeng law, his dereliction of duty was also true.
It was not his credit for recovering the tax money, so how could the court exempt him from the death penalty?
Even if he is given leniency, he is still exiled to the frontier.
"Sir Xu, this is your official robe. Put it away." The official presented the green robe of the eighth-grade military attaché that he had taken off earlier.
He was actually returned to his post...Xu Pingzhi realized something was wrong, and while taking over the official robe, he said in a deep voice: "My lord, can you help me clear up my doubts?"
With the official robe in hand, I feel confident when I say this.
Logically speaking, even if he is exempted from the death penalty, he should not be reinstated.
"The law stipulates that if an elder in the family triggers the law, the children can make meritorious deeds for their father's crimes," the official said.
"It's really Nian'er, sir. Nian'er helped the court recover the tax money." Li Ru cried with joy.
"Nian'er..." Xu Pingzhi's eyes were wet: "My good son."
The official glanced at the excited couple and said, "It's your nephew Xu Qian. He helped Mr. Fu Yin solve the tax and bank case. He just left."
